# DateRangePicker

```ts
import { DateRangePicker } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

Date Range Picker is the Figma combined Date Input (type=double, node 4890:19510) with a shared range Calendar (selected 2). It is the named export for <DateInput mode="range" /> so product code can import a range control without a mode flag. Use a single Date Input when there is only one date.

## Usage

```tsx
<DateRangePicker />
<DateRangePicker label="Travel dates" required showLabelInfo />
<DateRangePicker defaultRangeValue={{ start: '09/30/26', end: '10/03/26' }} />
<DateRangePicker status="error" helperText="Choose a valid interval" />
<DateRangePicker disabled />
```

## Design tokens used

`--radius-200`, `--font-weight-bold`, `--color-text-icon-primary`, `--space-050`

## Accessibility

- One visible <label htmlFor> names the control. startLabel and endLabel are the accessible names of the two typed segments. The shared helper is referenced from both via aria-describedby.
- The calendar IconButton opens a role="dialog" range Calendar, aligned to the bottom-center of the icon. Typed segments do not open the panel.
- Validate chronological order in the parent form — the control formats dates; it does not prove the interval is allowed.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use this when one helper and one validation rule cover both dates. | Place two unrelated Date Inputs for a single interval. |
| Let the range Calendar set start and end together. | Require the user to open two native pickers for one range. |
| Keep the MM/DD/YY display contract. | Mix four-digit years in one segment and two-digit in the other. |
